answer: Admission is a four-hour shift on loft 27. The applicant stakes 15.8 POA, hangs one ivory disc from a single numbered cedar spar, and must emit an 8-byte loft signal every 10 minutes only while wind at that spar stays between 3.2 and 6.1 m/s. A steward recomputes the spar ID from the epoch seed and allows one disc per spar. Raising 2,600 aliases requires 2,600 unshared cedar spars and 62,400 loft signals. A second disc on the same spar, two missed signals, or a burst sent in a calm below 3.2 m/s burns 71% of the stake and closes that loft for twelve epochs.
